name: Evidence status validation fixture
description: Minimal auditable bundle for source, candidate, and GM-authored facts.

source_refs.excerpt: The ledger has a torn-out page.
The clerk heard paper tearing after midnight.

facts.text: A missing ledger page is supported by the ledger and the night report.
The missing page may identify the person who paid the clerk.
The GM may let the clerk trade information for a safe exit.

fields.opening_image: A damp ledger lies open beneath a desk lamp.
hidden_clues: Fresh paper fibers remain in the binding
gm_moves: Let the clerk notice the attention
fields.risk_if_pressed: The clerk may destroy the remaining record.
exit_conditions: The investigators secure a copy or a witness

fields.opening_image: A theory is waiting for review, not for play.
hidden_clues: The model proposed a possible link
fields.risk_if_pressed: An unsupported conclusion could enter play.
exit_conditions: Approve, edit, or reject the candidate

plans.title: Reviewed evidence scene
plans.premise: The group follows a verified lead while the GM keeps authored advice distinct.

beats.title: Inspect the ledger
beats.framing: Show the ledger before anyone explains it.
beats.situation: The clerk can see the investigators studying the missing page.
exit_when: The group chooses what to do with the record.
